title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-prep-jamie-2026-03-23
content:
Weekly partner & cloud marketplace sync — prep notes (Jamie)
Date: 2026-03-23
Owner: Jamie Park
Attendees (planned): Redwood: Jamie Park, Ava Patel, Miguel Santos; AWS: Priya R.; Azure: Lukas M.; GCP: Sarah T.; Channel partner rep: Nate H.

Purpose / goals for this sync:
- Quick status updates across AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listings and open CTA items.
- Align on upcoming joint marketing push (April) and co-sell enablement timeline.
- Confirm next steps on billing integration for Azure marketplace and AWS usage-based listing review.
- Surface any blockers that need executive escalation this week.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick intros & top priorities (3m)
2) Marketplace health updates (10m) — each cloud partner 3 mins
   - Listing status, recent policy feedback, go-live blockers
3) Billing & procurement items (6m) — Azure billing reconciliation, AWS metering confirmation
4) Co-marketing & upcoming webinar (5m) — alignment on dates, assets, speaker commitments
5) Action items & next steps (6m)

Prep notes / talking points
- AWS: ask for update on usage-based metering review (ticket recency: JIRA-PM-542). Confirm expected sign-off date. If >1w delay, propose escalation to Mari (AWS alliances).
- Azure: billing integration still in sandbox; need confirmation of invoice schema. Miguel to demo current mapping during sync (2m).
- GCP: listing passed security review; ask about timeline for regional availability (APAC region request from Sales).
- Channel partner (Nate): wants clarity on lead routing and attribution window for co-sell (30/60/90d?). Recommend 30d for initial pilot.
- Marketing/webinar: proposed date 2026-04-14; ask partners to confirm speakers by 2026-03-30. Need placeholder copy and 1-pager by next week. Ava to share draft.

Metrics / recent signals to call out
- Listings traffic (last 14d): AWS listing CTR +12% after new screenshots; Azure listing impressions down 8% post-policy update.
- New leads attributed via marketplace (Mar): 12 MQLs (AWS 7, Azure 3, GCP 2) — conversion follow-up required.

Risks / blockers
- Azure billing schema mismatch — could delay paid listing activation (impact: revenue recognition & customer onboarding).
- AWS metering ticket backlog — if not cleared, usage-based billing launch slips by 2+ weeks.
- Marketing assets are behind; we need speaker confirmations to lock date.

Proposed asks for partners during sync
- AWS: get firm sign-off ETA on metering (target: 2026-03-30) and confirm whether additional documentation needed.
- Azure: approve invoice schema or provide sample invoice (due 2026-03-27).
- GCP: confirm APAC region availability window (target: by next sync).
- Channel partner: confirm pilot lead routing rules (30d) and sample SOW template.

Open items I will cover / demos
- Miguel: quick demo of current Azure billing mapping (2m) — show fields that mismatch.
- Ava: share marketing deck outline and 1-pager link post-meeting.
- I (Jamie): summarize MQL pipeline and ask for lead handoff cadence.

Action items (owners & due dates)
- Miguel Santos: demo Azure invoice mapping and provide sample corrected mapping file — due 2026-03-24.
- AWS team / Priya: confirm metering sign-off date or list outstanding docs — due 2026-03-30.
- Ava Patel: draft webinar 1-pager and speaker list; circulate for review — due 2026-03-27.
- Nate H. (channel): confirm lead routing rules and sample SOW — due 2026-03-25.
- Jamie Park: follow up on JIRA-PM-542 and escalate to Mari at AWS if no firm ETA by 2026-03-30.

Notes to self (post-meeting)
- If AWS sign-off slips, prepare escalation note for Monday exec sync and include expected revenue impact.
- Check with Legal on any Azure invoice terms that could affect revenue recognition (linked artifact: CONFLUENCE-PRTNR-42).
- Update partner playbook (drive: shared_drives/go-to-market/partners/playbooks) with lead routing decision after Nate confirms.

Quick checklist before meeting
- [ ] Confirm attendee list + dial-in (Ava)
- [ ] Miguel ready to share demo file
- [ ] Upload latest listing screenshots to shared drive (done)
- [ ] Bring JIRA ticket summary for AWS metering

End — will convert notes to follow-up summary and assign tasks in Asana after sync.
